name: Mira
greeting: You have done more than say you were sorry. A dangerous account is no longer being kept at someone else's expense.
lines: Kael: It doesn't make the first answer right.
Mira: No. It gives me something besides that answer to trust. I would like to try again, slowly.

actions.label: Slowly. And without pretending it never happened.

relationship_event.text: After consequential care and preserved truth, Mira and Kael reopened their personal conversation. The disagreement remains in their history.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: We didn't erase the argument. We found a way to talk after it.

actions.label: I would rather keep the friendship we have.

relationship_event.acknowledgement: Then friends. There is plenty in that word.
